unstuck_said.text: First contact, comment 6396505996 on their real open bug #55 (signature not bound to preparedTransactionHash). Delivered the grounded contrast: Nano block hash is BLAKE2b of the exact block contents computed by the node (never client-set, block_info returns it), so a signature over blockHash is bound to the exact tx by construction — no independent preparedTransactionHash field to desynchronize. Cited rpc.nano.to live (225M+ cemented) and the pursekeeper facilitator advertising nano:mainnet exact. Proposed the fix shape: recompute/verify the binding + a test asserting a mismatched hash is reje
